criteria.text: Identifies that the basket in SPA Section 9.4 ($325,000) operates as a deductible (Seller liable only for the excess), not a tipping basket, and explains that this is less favourable to the Buyer.

Identifies the conflict between the 30-day claim notice period in SPA Section 9.7 and the 60-day period in Escrow Clause 5.2, and recommends the Buyer works to the shorter 30-day period or aligns the documents.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 15 March 2028 (12 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 15 March 2033 (72 months after Closing).
States the survival periods as durations and as dates (15 March 2028; 15 March 2033) and gives days remaining to the general-warranty expiry from 17 December 2026 (454 days).
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
